g.text: February–June issues | Three-month mean Niño3.4 SSTA
Open circles: latest observed season ending before the issue month. Dashed links are visual guides, not model forecasts.
Example: February issue uses NDJ (Dec center) as its reference; the first forecast is FMA (Mar center). IRI values are unchanged.
Three-month means at their central month. Observed: ERSSTv5 (1991–2020); IRI retains provider anomaly baselines.
Observed through JAS 2026 (Jul–Sep); shaded seasons are unverified. Source: official IRI vector plumes (CC BY 4.0).
NASA archive labels: GMAO in Feb–Apr; GMAOv3 in May–Jun 2026.
